findings.quote: a count of everything the island has ever held rather than of anything it holds now
findings.note: Intellectual temperature/rhythm: three paragraphs close on the same antithetical cadence built on the cumulative-vs-current axis (this one, 'because a ratchet cannot report a loss even when the loss is most of what has happened', 'the one that was never able to fall'). host-2021-verb2-ELF-040 allows itself authorial flourish but does not repeat one figure at paragraph ends. Not disqualifying — the reportorial substrate (nineteen summers, seven islands, medians, the quoted volcanologist, the Odren counter-case) is thicker than the exemplar's — but it is the one seam where the prose reads composed.
